definition.zh-TW: 公司法規定從每年盈餘中提撥、不能隨便發出去的公積。它仍然屬於權益，只是把一部分盈餘留在公司裡；本課未用。
definition.en: A reserve that company law requires to be set aside from each year's profit and that cannot be freely distributed. It remains part of equity; it simply keeps part of the profit inside the company. Not used in this course.
